text: The purpose of this report is to seek Board ratification of the updated collective bargaining agreement between IATSE Local B-173 and Civic Theatres Toronto.

The Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto: 1. Adopted and ratified the updated collective agreement between IATSE Local B-173 and the Civic Theatres Toronto Board, all as more particularly noted in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (January 10, 2018) from the Vice President of Operations. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (January 10, 201) from the Vice President of Operations remain confidential as it pertains to labour relations or employee negotiations.
